name: unset_symbol
source: SAY foo

name: unset_compound
source:
LET i = 2
SAY list.i

name: substituted_tail
source:
LET i = 2
LET list.i = 'x'
SAY list.2 list.i

name: substituted_property_collision
source:
LET key = 'x'
LET data.x = 7
LET data.key = 8
SAY data.key data.x

name: multiple_tail_parts
source:
LET i = 2
LET j = 3
LET list.i.j = 'x'
SAY list.2.3

name: procedure_generation
source:
LET x = 'outer'
CALL work
SAY x RESULT
EXIT
work: PROCEDURE
SAY x
LET x = 'inner'
RETURN x

name: procedure_expose
source:
LET total = 10
CALL add 5
SAY total
EXIT
add: PROCEDURE EXPOSE total
ARG amount
total = total + amount
RETURN

name: procedure_recursion
source:
CALL fact 5
SAY RESULT
EXIT
fact: PROCEDURE
ARG n
IF n <= 1 THEN RETURN 1
CALL fact n - 1
RETURN n * RESULT

name: builtin_call_expression
source:
LET n = 4
CALL ABS n - 7
SAY RESULT

name: builtin_call_zero
source:
LET n = 0
CALL ABS n
SAY RESULT

name: blank_concatenation
source:
LET v = 'a'
v = v 'b'
SAY v

name: abuttal
source:
LET v = 'a'
v = v'b'
SAY v

name: blank_in_call
source:
LET a = 'x'
LET n = LENGTH(a 'yz')
SAY n

name: abuttal_in_call
source:
LET a = 'x'
LET n = LENGTH(a'yz')
SAY n

name: unparenthesized_builtin
source:
LET s = 'hello'
LET x = UPPER s
SAY x

name: range_termination
source:
DO i = 1 TO 2
END
SAY i

name: descending_termination
source:
DO i = 3 TO 1
END
SAY i

name: existing_loop_variable
source:
LET i = 99
DO i = 1 TO 2
END
SAY i

name: over_stem
source:
LET stem.1 = 'a'
LET stem.2 = 'b'
DO v OVER stem
SAY v
END

name: over_stem_period
source:
LET stem.1 = 'a'
LET stem.2 = 'b'
DO v OVER stem.
SAY v
END

name: next_line_instruction
source:
IF 1 = 1 THEN
SAY 'yes'
ELSE
SAY 'no'

name: next_line_then
source:
IF 1 = 1
THEN SAY 'yes'
ELSE SAY 'no'

name: command_concatenation
source:
LET n = 3
ADDRESS APP
'SET n=' || n

name: logical_condition
source:
IF 1 = 1 | 0 = 1 THEN SAY 'or'
IF 1 = 1 & 0 = 1 THEN SAY 'bad'
ELSE SAY 'and'
